اقتبسوا (form VIII)
# اِقْتَبَسُوا (iqtabasū) /iq.ta.ba.suː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# اُقْتُبِسُوا (uqtubisū) /uq.tu.bi.suː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
# اِقْتَبِسُوا (iqtabisū) /iq.ta.bi.suː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِقْتَبَسَ (iqtabasa)
